module: "Driveline Editor" tab of the rally editor. It loads a mission's driving line (driveline) from a raw recording, from the saved final line (spline file) or from the race path (detailed AI path), then lets you edit it as a spline (nodes, widths) via DrivelineEditSurface, simplify it, save it and recompute its race distance. It also computes the stage statistics (distance in km and tarmac/gravel/ice/snow surface percentages by sampling the terrain) and writes them into the spline file under the key "stats". The module returns a constructor (class C). It relies on DrivelineV3 for the data.
notes: Loading modes (self.loadMode): 'recording', 'final', 'race'. Without a final file, loadFromFinal() creates an empty spline with speedLimitKph = 100 and liaisonAllocatedTimeMins = 5.
loadFromRace() always uses the detailed AI path (hard-coded option); the pathnodes branch is dead code. The RDP simplification tolerance is 4.0 m.

Surface: one sample every 5 m along the start -> finish section, classified by groundmodel name (tables hard-coded in the file). rock, grass and other are merged into the dominant surface if it exceeds 90% of the samples, otherwise into gravel. Result rounded to 0.1%.
computeSurfacePercentages writes many debug lines to the log ([surfaceProbe]).
calculatedRaceDistance is nil (not computed), false (failure) or a number in meters.
getDrivelineLength and getDrivelinePointCount only return a non-zero value in 'recording' mode.
The 10 m radius buffer is marked experimental; the button displays "30m" but bufferRadius is 10.0 in the code (label inconsistency).

C.desc: Tab object returned by the constructor (new(rallyEditor)). Main fields: path (notebook), drivelineV3, drivelineLoaded, loadMode, loadError, isSplineView, showRawPoints, showFinalDrivelineVisualization, calculatedRaceDistance, drivelineStats {pointCount, length}, bufferEnabled/bufferPoints/bufferRadius/bufferBounds. windowDescription = 'Driveline Editor'.

init.desc: Internal constructor: initializes the UI, editing and buffer state.

clearState.desc: Resets all state (notebook, loaded driveline, statistics, buffer).

setPath.desc: Sets the current notebook. If the mission folder changes, the loading state is reset. Creates the mission's DrivelineV3 object if needed and automatically loads the final line if it exists.

splineEditCallbacks.desc: Returns the callbacks passed to DrivelineEditSurface: onCommit and onHistoryRestore recompute the race distance.

selected.desc: Called by the editor when the tab is selected: emits onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil) to redraw the shortcut legend.

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: emits onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil).

formatDistance.desc: Formats a distance in meters: "0m" if zero, otherwise 3 decimals, in km above 950 m.

getFinalDrivelineLength.desc: Sum of the distances between consecutive points of the final line (finalDrivelinePoints).

formatDurationSecs.desc: Formats a duration in seconds as "MM:SS.d" (rounded tenths). "N/A" if nil or <= 0.

getMissionSilverTimeSecs.desc: Reads missionTypeData.silverTime in the mission's info.json.

returns.desc: Silver time in seconds, or nil if absent or non-positive.

hasRecording.desc: Tests whether the mission's raw driveline recording file exists.

hasFinalDriveline.desc: Tests whether the driveline spline file exists or, failing that, the final driveline file.

loadFromRecording.desc: Loads and processes the driveline from the raw recording via DrivelineV3, switches to 'recording' mode and recomputes the distance. On failure, fills loadError.

loadFromFinal.desc: Loads the saved driveline; if there is none, creates an empty spline with default properties. Switches to 'final' mode.

loadFromRace.desc: Builds a spline from the mission's race path (detailed AI path points), updates the geometry and switches to 'race' mode. Fails if the race has no AI path.

returns.desc: true if the spline was created.

getDrivelineLength.desc: Length of the raw path in 'recording' mode.

getDrivelinePointCount.desc: Number of raw points in 'recording' mode.

returns.desc: Number of points, 0 in other modes.

updateSplineGeometry.desc: Recomputes the spline geometry (DrivelineV3) then the race distance.

deepCopySpline.desc: Deep copy of the spline, used for undo/redo.

undoSplineEdit.desc: Undo callback for a spline edit; restores the state then recomputes the race distance.

redoSplineEdit.desc: Redo callback for a spline edit; then recomputes the race distance.

createDrivelineFromSpline.desc: Generates the final line (finalDrivelinePoints) from the edited spline then recomputes the distance.

recalculateDrivelineStats.desc: Updates drivelineStats with the point count and length of the final line.

recalculateRaceDistance.desc: If a driveline is loaded, regenerates the final line from the spline, updates the stats then computes the race distance. Otherwise resets the values to zero.

returns.desc: Race distance in meters, or nil.

createTempRallyManager.desc: Creates a temporary RallyManager for the mission, injecting the drivelineV3 being edited (even if unsaved), to compute distance and start/finish against the editor's geometry.

returns.desc: RallyManager, or nil if there is no notebook, no mission, or if the resources cannot be rebuilt.

calculateRaceDistance.desc: Computes the race distance via a temporary RallyManager (getRaceDistanceMeters) and stores it in calculatedRaceDistance (false on failure).

setAverageSpeedFromSilverTimeAndRaceDist.desc: Sets properties.speedLimitKph to distance / silver time (in km/h, minimum 0). Requires the mission's silver time and a computed distance.

returns.desc: true if the speed was changed.

computeSurfacePercentages.desc: Probes the terrain groundmodel (one sample every 5 m) along the driveline between start and finish and returns the percentage per surface category (tarmac, gravel, ice, snow; only the non-zero ones).

returns.desc: Percentages with 1 decimal, or nil if impossible (no points, no terrain, no sample).

refreshStats.desc: Recomputes distance (raceDistanceKms, 3 decimals) and surface percentages, puts them in drivelineV3.stats then saves the spline file.

returns.desc: true if the stats were computed and saved.

saveFinalDriveline.desc: Saves the final driveline/spline (delegates to DrivelineEditSurface.saveFinalDriveline).

generateBuffer.desc: Experimental: builds the buffer zone around the final line (list of positions and bounding box enlarged by bufferRadius) and enables bufferEnabled.

returns.desc: false if there are no final line points.

isPointInBuffer.desc: Tests whether a point is within bufferRadius of a buffer point (fast rejection by bounding box).

returns.desc: false if the buffer is not active.

draw.desc: Draws the imgui interface: source choice, display options, spline simplification and saving, final line display, statistics ("Refresh Stats"), properties (speed limit, raycast...) and the experimental buffer.

drawDebugEntrypoint.desc: Called every frame for 3D rendering: raw path (recording mode), spline interaction, geometry update if needed, final line display.

handleSplineInteraction.desc: Handles mouse and keyboard to edit the spline (delegates to DrivelineEditSurface.handleSplineInteraction with splineEditCallbacks).
